rationale.text: A visible iframe is named with aria-label and has no title attribute. The test asks for a title attribute specifically, and the glossary defines the frame title as the content of the title attribute; an aria-label is not one. The frame is not hidden with aria-hidden, so the technical-frame note cannot apply. The custom check ignores aria-label and faults the frame (step 5), so the finding is failed at both levels. axe's frame-title accepts aria-label and reports no fault, which changes nothing: its link is evidence only.

citations.quote: Chaque cadre (balise `<iframe>` ou `<frame>`) a-t-il un attribut `title`
